verified_fixes.issue: Inpainting silently defaulted to the model square sample size because width/height were omitted; non-square input could fail PIL compositing or become misaligned.
verified_fixes.evidence: Installed Diffusers 0.30.3 pipeline_stable_diffusion_inpaint.py defaults height/width from unet sample_size at lines1053–1054. Real repaired run produced384×216 and preserved78,541 outside-mask pixels exactly.
verified_fixes.change: Pass image.width/image.height to inpaint, and reject mismatched output dimensions before composite.

verified_fixes.issue: No one-command cross-platform isolated installer was provided.
verified_fixes.change: Added setup_native.py, check_runtime.py, start_native.command and start_native.bat. Select Intel Mac Torch2.2.2; Linux/Windows Torch2.6.0 CPU. Enforce Python3.11 and package pins. Existing complete models are reusable offline.

verified_fixes.issue: New memory harness initially used psutil.Process() in a PID namespace whose /proc view did not match; initial Pix2Pix RSS was incorrect and first Inpaint harness attempt raised NoSuchProcess before inference.
verified_fixes.change: Linux/macOS now use kernel RUSAGE_SELF ru_maxrss; Windows retains sampled psutil RSS. Repeated both real inference runs using repaired harness.
verified_fixes.preliminary_outcome: Pix2Pix15-step256×144 inference succeeded in30.04815378sec, but that measurement report was superseded because its memory metric was invalid.
